payload.name: pc-check-weighted-entries
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw list of weighted entries and returns whether it is well-formed. Each entry must be a JSON object with exactly the fields label and weight: label is a string of length 1..8 inclusive, weight is an exact integer 0..1 inclusive, never a boolean or float. Missing, null, extra item fields or invalid shapes fail closed without exceptions. Returns {ok: boolean, entries: original list if valid else []}. No imports, host calls, I/O or type coercion.
